tooling.message:
docs(site): link each block on the workshop page to its card in the architecture

## Intent

The boxes on the workshop page named building blocks but did not lead to them. Each should take the reader to its description in the architecture.

## Key changes

- Every line of the board, the band "In every phase" and the catalog links the block's card in the arc42 web app of this site (#<chapter file>:el-<id>). The chapter file comes from arc42 get.
- A line of several blocks links the first; its neighbours follow in chapter 5.
- A test checks the link format.
